kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننثقب (form VII)
# نَنْثَقِبُ (nanṯaqibu) /nan.θa.qi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# نَنْثَقِبَ (nanṯaqiba) /nan.θa.qi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# نَنْثَقِبْ (nanṯaqib) /nan.θa.qib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
